title: Yummy Smoky Indian Pepper Curry
description: A fragrant, smoky pepper curry that soothes hangovers with its warming spices and hearty chickpeas.
instructions: Heat a large pan over medium heat and toast the cumin seeds until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add the black peppercorns, smoked paprika, coriander powder, and turmeric, stirring constantly for 1 minute to bloom the spices.
Pour in the diced tomatoes and cook until they break down and form a thick sauce, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the chickpeas and water, bring the mixture to a gentle simmer, and let it cook for 10 minutes to meld the flavors.
While the curry simmers, whisk the coconut milk in a bowl until it is smooth and slightly frothy.
Pour the whisked coconut milk into the pan, stir, and simmer for another 5 minutes until the curry thickens.
Remove from heat, stir in chopped cilantro, and let it rest for 5 minutes to develop a mellow aroma.
Serve the smoky pepper curry hot over steamed rice or with warm naan, and enjoy its restorative, hangover-cure properties.
